name: Jeshaiah
overview: Jeshaiah was a male descendant of Elam and the son of Athaliah. He is noted in Scripture for his participation in the return with Ezra, as recorded in Ezra 8:7. Beyond these details, Scripture does not provide additional information about his tribe or other distinguishing notes.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeshaiah means 'YHWH will save,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning connected to God's saving power. This proper name, recorded in Ezra 8:7, highlights the believer's trust in God's deliverance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Jeshaiah was the son of Athaliah, as noted in Ezra 8:7. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jeshaiah's significance lies in his role as a returning exile who accompanied Ezra from Babylon to Jerusalem. His lineage as a descendant of Elam and his inclusion in the company led by Ezra underscore the faithfulness of God's people in returning to their land and covenant. This participation reflects the ongoing fulfillment of God's promises to restore His people.
